Design, configure, test, and commission substation protection, automation, SCADA, and communication systems for Solar PV, BESS, Natural Gas Generation Facilities, collector substations, switching stations and transmission interconnections (12 kV through 500 kV). jobs.description: Job Summary Sr./Lead QA Automation Engineer - AI Agent Are you a quality engineer who wants to build confidence in a fast-evolving AI agent - not just execute manual test cases. We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and evolve the quality strategy for this product. The product's risk sits in cross-service behavior - where agent runs, tool calls, external integrations, and cloud infrastructure meet. The role blends hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features and AI behavior with designing and building the automated test system - acceptance, integration, contract, and post-deployment validation - that lets the team ship quickly without breaking critical engineering workflows. Responsibilities Test strategy and hands-on testing Define and own the products test strategy across unit, functional, integration, acceptance, post-deployment, and exploratory testing. Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features, AI-agent behavior, and edge cases before and alongside automation. Design approaches for testing non-deterministic AI/LLM behavior, tool-use correctness, and prompt regressions. Automated coverage Build browser-level acceptance tests that cover key user journeys end to end, from the UI down to persistence and background processing. Create validation for MCP endpoints, including authentication flows, client compatibility, and tool schemas. Design contract and replay-based tests for critical external integrations where live systems are slow, expensive, or unstable. Strengthen test coverage for the highest-risk execution surfaces: sandboxed code execution and the agents remote sessions on user machines. Release confidence and test infrastructure Add post-deployment smoke tests that catch environment, configuration, and identity failures, giving rollback confidence. Introduce failure-injection scenarios - service restarts, network loss, expired tokens, rate limits - to prove the product degrades gracefully. Improve test data, fixtures, fake connectors, and CI test categorization; manage flaky tests and keep pipelines fast and trustworthy. Collaboration and quality leadership Partner with engineers to make features testable and define acceptance criteria before implementation; mentor the team in testing practices. Monitor quality signals from CI, static analysis, telemetry, production incidents, and user feedback, and build release-readiness reporting. What we value Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We expect you to be strong in several of the following and interested in learning the rest: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. 6+ years of experience in quality engineering / test automation for complex web and API platforms. Strong C#/.NET test development skills: xUnit/NUnit-style frameworks, mocks and fakes, test fixtures, and CI integration. Solid experience with API and integration testing, including authentication and distributed-system failure modes. Experience with browser automation such as Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent. Strong manual and exploratory testing skills, and the ability to design test strategies rather than only execute predefined cases. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, test categorization, flaky-test management, and post-deployment smoke testing.
